headline: Godcrofts Surges; Lykos Isle, Tempest Flare
war_summary: Three hours after the last edition the front shows sharper localized clashes while the massive attrition corridors stay static. Godcrofts has intensified, logging seventeen ownership flips in the past day — nine in the last six hours — with the newest turnover at 10:25 UTC around Argosa and Lipsia. Lykos Isle remains hot, adding eleven flips in twenty‑four hours, the latest at 10:10 UTC near The Squall and Fort Guile. Tempest Island, quiet since 01:27 UTC, recorded two fresh captures in the last six hours, the most recent at 09:33 UTC at Blackwatch and Surge Gate. Dead Lands, still the bloodiest sector, added roughly 1,450 Colonial and 1,800 Warden casualties in the last two hours but its daily flip count fell to nine, the newest at 04:10 UTC. Fishermans Row and Stema Landing have gone silent after earlier bursts, their latest events dated 22:25 UTC and 23:52 UTC yesterday. The high‑casualty belts — Weathered Expanse, Callahans Passage, Kings Cage, Marban Hollow, Loch Mor, Stlican Shelf and Stonecradle — continue to post rising losses with zero territorial movement. Overall strategic‑base ownership is largely unchanged, Colonials holding the western and southern arcs, Wardens the northern and eastern.
